Descriptions

The white sideboard described is a stylish and practical storage solution that will enhance any living space with its elegant design and functional features. With a length of 140 cm, a width of 35 cm and a height of 76 cm, it offers an ideal balance between generous storage capacity and space efficiency. With its seven drawers, this sideboard offers versatile storage options for organizing various household items. Each drawer is equipped with smooth-running sliding rails that allow the drawers to be opened and closed effortlessly without interference or blockages. This feature not only increases convenience but also contributes to a pleasant overall look for the user. A touch of elegance and sophistication is added by the golden handles and table legs. These accents complement the white surface beautifully, creating a visually appealing contrast that adds a touch of luxury to the piece of furniture. The golden handles not only serve as a stylish ornament, but are also practical as they allow easy access to the drawers. In addition, the table legs are equipped with black foot pads that ensure the protection of floor coverings. Not only do they prevent scratches and damage, but they also help to minimize noise and vibration, making the use of the sideboard smoother and more stable. This attention to detail reflects the manufacturer's commitment to form and function. In conclusion, the white sideboard with seven drawers, golden handles and table legs is a versatile and stylish addition to any home. Its combination of aesthetics, functional design and thoughtful details makes it a valuable piece of furniture that enhances both the look and the usability of any room.
